name: Lattice Golomb-Welch conjecture for Lee balls of radius three in dimensions 35 and 805 (proved)
target: Xiao-Zhou open cases: no lattice tiling of Z^35 or Z^805 by Lee balls of radius three
result: True for both dimensions, closing the lattice Golomb-Welch conjecture for all Lee balls of dimension >= 3 and radius >= 2 with fewer than 2^30 points. Constructions: group-ring equations for the tiling group and exclusion of the abelian groups of the right order.
